basic_profile.bio: GalacticLabrador is a 29-year-old software engineer from Toronto, Canada, who has been exploring the depths of Reddit since university days. With a passion for astronomy and a soft spot for superhero lore, they spend their free time diving into the intricacies of space-time theories and DC comics, especially anything related to Superman. Apart from their digital pursuits, they are an avid dog lover, often sharing insights and pictures of their beloved labradoodle, Luna. Typically active during late evenings, especially after work, they balance their time between coding, Reddit, and gaming. In a long-term relationship with a fellow tech enthusiast, they cherish meaningful online interactions and are always eager to help others.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: GalacticLabrador possesses a robust understanding of computer science, having graduated with a degree in Software Engineering. Their expertise extends to AI and machine learning, acquired through self-taught courses and professional experience. Additionally, their knowledge of astronomy stems from years of reading scientific journals and participating in amateur stargazing events.
